name: Soil pH
description: Soil pH measures hydrogen ion concentration in soil solution, determining whether the soil is acidic, neutral, or alkaline.
importance: Directly controls solubility and availability of all essential macro and micronutrients, dictates soil microbial activity, and determines root cell membrane permeability.

classification_bands.strongly_acidic: < 5.5 (risk of Aluminum and Manganese toxicity; Phosphorus fixation)
classification_bands.moderately_acidic: 5.5 - 6.5 (tolerable for tea, potato, coffee; slightly restricted nodulation)
classification_bands.moderately_alkaline: 7.5 - 8.5 (risk of Iron, Zinc, and Manganese deficiencies)
classification_bands.strongly_alkaline: > 8.5 (saline/sodic conditions, poor soil structure, osmotic moisture stress)

remediation.acidic_soils: Incorporate agricultural limestone (CaCO3) or dolomitic lime at least 4-6 weeks before sowing.
remediation.alkaline_soils: Apply agricultural gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O), elemental sulfur, and organic matter with good drainage flushing.
